description: This file provides authentication utilities including password hashing, JWT token creation and decoding, and an AuthUser dataclass for representing authenticated users. It facilitates secure user authentication by handling password security and token management.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: Represents an authenticated user's identity extracted from a JWT, including user ID, email, and admin status.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a hashed password.

methods.name: str create_access_token(*, user_id: str, email: str, is_admin: bool)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token containing user information, issued by the server.

methods.name: AuthUser decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, returning an AuthUser object if valid.

methods.name: None require(condition: bool, err: DomainError)
methods.description: Raises a specified error if a condition is false.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(*, user_id: str, email: str, is_admin: bool) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (*, user_id: str, email: str, is_admin: bool)
